## Featured Projects
- [TrekDesk AI](https://udarashanuka.axiolon.com/client/projects/trekdesk-ai): Real-time AI voice/chat booking assistant (RAG, Gemini Live API, Cloud Run).

- [Kandy Trekking Tours](https://udarashanuka.axiolon.com/client/projects/kandy-trekking-tours): High-performance trekking platform (Next.js, Vercel Edge).
- [University-SSO](https://udarashanuka.axiolon.com/recruiter/projects/university-sso): Next.js monorepo with centralized WSO2 SSO and ArgoCD GitOps.
- [Multi-Cloud Terraform](https://udarashanuka.axiolon.com/recruiter/projects/multi-cloud-terraform-infrastructure): Hybrid IaC orchestration on AWS and GCP.
- [Scalable Ecommerce API](https://udarashanuka.axiolon.com/recruiter/projects/ecommerce-api): Managed Express microservice with WSO2 API Manager.
- [Lover Shop E-Commerce](https://udarashanuka.axiolon.com/recruiter/projects/rosalover-ecommerce): Spring Boot, MongoDB, AWS S3 e-commerce.
